query: What products does Nexora offer?
ground_truth_answer: Nexora offers NexaDesk (AI-powered helpdesk), NexaFlow (workflow automation) and NexaInsight (analytics), all sharing one login and one platform.
relevant_contexts: Nexora offers NexaDesk (AI-powered helpdesk), NexaFlow (workflow automation) and NexaInsight (analytics). They share one login and one platform.

query: What is the discount for paying annually instead of monthly?
ground_truth_answer: Annual billing is approximately 20% cheaper than monthly billing, and annual plans are invoiced once a year in advance.
relevant_contexts: Annual billing is approximately 20% cheaper than monthly billing. Annual plans are invoiced once a year in advance.

query: If I cancel my subscription, how many days do I have to get a refund?
ground_truth_answer: Refunds are available within 14 days of the first paid charge; after that, annual plans are not refunded pro rata.
relevant_contexts: Refunds are available within 14 days of the first paid charge; after that, annual plans are not refunded pro rata.

query: What file types can I upload to the NexaDesk knowledge base?
ground_truth_answer: HTML, Markdown, PDF and DOCX files, up to 100,000 characters per article; ticket attachments can be up to 25 MB per file.
relevant_contexts: HTML, Markdown, PDF and DOCX, up to 100,000 characters per article. Attachments on tickets can be up to 25 MB per file.

query: What is the API rate limit on the Growth plan?
ground_truth_answer: The Growth plan allows 300 API requests per minute, with short bursts of up to twice the limit for 10 seconds.
relevant_contexts: 60 requests per minute on Starter, 300 on Growth and 1,200 on Enterprise, with short bursts of up to twice the limit for 10 seconds.

query: Is single sign-on (SSO) available on the Starter plan?
ground_truth_answer: No. SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect SSO are available only on the Enterprise plan; Starter and Growth use email and password with optional two-factor authentication.
relevant_contexts: SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect SSO are available on the Enterprise plan only. Starter and Growth use email and password with optional two-factor authentication.

query: What sourcing and approval are required for a purchase worth PKR 1,500,000?
ground_truth_answer: A purchase of PKR 1,500,000 falls in Tier 3 (500,001 to 2,500,000), requiring 3 quotations and a comparative statement, approved by the department head and CFO.
relevant_contexts: 500,001 to 2,500,000 | 3 quotations and a comparative statement | Department head and CFO

query: Can an emergency purchase to restore a production service skip the normal approval process?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, emergency purchases needed to restore a production service may proceed with verbal approval from the CTO or CFO, but the purchase order must be raised within 2 working days.
relevant_contexts: Emergency purchases needed to restore a production service may proceed with verbal approval of the CTO or CFO; the PO must be raised within 2 working days.

query: What documents does a vendor need to provide before onboarding?
ground_truth_answer: A vendor must provide its NTN and sales tax registration (STRN), active taxpayer status, bank account details on company letterhead, a signed conflict-of-interest declaration, and, for IT vendors, an InfoSec questionnaire. Vendors are re-reviewed every 2 years.
relevant_contexts: Procurement collects the vendor's NTN and sales tax registration (STRN), active taxpayer status, bank account details on company letterhead, a signed conflict-of-interest declaration and, for IT vendors, an InfoSec questionnaire. Vendors are re-reviewed every 2 years.

query: What three documents must agree for an invoice to be paid under the three-way match?
ground_truth_answer: The purchase order (PO), the goods receipt or service acceptance, and the vendor invoice must agree on quantity, price and terms for the invoice to be paid.
relevant_contexts: An invoice is paid only when the three-way match succeeds: the PO, the goods receipt or service acceptance, and the vendor invoice agree on quantity, price and terms.

query: How long are procurement files kept?
ground_truth_answer: Procurement files, including the requisition, quotations, evaluation, PO, GRN, invoice and payment, are retained for 7 years.
relevant_contexts: Procurement files (requisition, quotations, evaluation, PO, GRN, invoice, payment) are retained for 7 years.

query: How many days of annual leave does an employee get per year, and how many can be carried forward?
ground_truth_answer: Employees get 20 days of annual leave per year, accruing at 1.67 days per month, and up to 10 days can be carried forward to the next year.
relevant_contexts: Annual leave | 20 days per year | Up to 10 days | Accrues at 1.67 days per month.

query: How many calendar days of maternity leave are employees entitled to?
ground_truth_answer: Employees are entitled to 90 calendar days of paid maternity leave, which can start up to 4 weeks before the expected delivery date with medical documentation required.
relevant_contexts: Maternity leave | 90 calendar days (paid) | Not applicable | Can start up to 4 weeks before the expected delivery date. Medical documentation required.

query: By what date must carried-forward annual leave be used before it lapses?
ground_truth_answer: Carried-forward annual leave (up to 10 days) must be used by 31 March; any balance not used by then lapses.
relevant_contexts: A maximum of 10 days of unused annual leave carries forward to the next calendar year and must be used by 31 March; any carried-forward balance not used by then lapses.

query: Who needs to approve a leave request of 6 working days?
ground_truth_answer: A leave request of 4 to 10 working days requires approval from both the line manager and the department head, and should be requested with 2 weeks' advance notice.
relevant_contexts: 4 to 10 working days | Line manager and department head | 2 weeks

query: What happens if an employee is absent for 3 or more consecutive days without approval?
ground_truth_answer: It is treated as unauthorised absence and may lead to action under the disciplinary process described in the Employee Handbook (NX-HR-002, Section 8).
relevant_contexts: Absence of 3 or more consecutive working days without approval or communication is treated as unauthorised absence and may lead to action under the disciplinary process in the Employee Handbook (NX-HR-002, Section 8).

query: What is the daily per diem and hotel cap for a Grade G4 employee traveling domestically?
ground_truth_answer: A Grade G4 employee traveling domestically gets a per diem of PKR 8,000 per day and a hotel cap of PKR 20,000 per night, flying economy class.

query: What is the reimbursement limit for a business meal with colleagues?
ground_truth_answer: Business meals (working lunch or dinner with colleagues) are reimbursed up to PKR 2,500 per person, with attendee names and business purpose required on the claim.
relevant_contexts: Business meals (working lunch or dinner with colleagues) | PKR 2,500 per person | Names of attendees and business purpose on the claim

query: How many calendar days does an employee have to submit an expense claim?
ground_truth_answer: Claims must be submitted in the Expense portal within 15 calendar days of the expense (or of return from travel); later claims need the CFO office's exception approval.
relevant_contexts: All claims are submitted in the Expense portal within 15 calendar days of the expense (or of return from travel). Claims submitted later require the CFO office's exception approval.

query: Who must approve an expense claim above PKR 200,000?
ground_truth_answer: An expense claim above PKR 200,000 requires approval from the department head and the CFO office.
relevant_contexts: Above PKR 200,000 | Department head and CFO office

query: Are alcohol purchases reimbursable as a business expense?
ground_truth_answer: No, alcohol or any prohibited item is listed as a non-reimbursable expense, along with traffic fines, personal shopping, and expenses without a receipt above PKR 500.
relevant_contexts: Traffic fines, parking penalties and vehicle repairs; alcohol or any prohibited item; personal shopping, entertainment or gifts.

query: What is the canary rollout schedule for stateless service deployments?
ground_truth_answer: The new version first receives 5% of traffic for 15 minutes, then 25% for 15 minutes, and finally 100%; the API Gateway instead uses blue-green deployment.
relevant_contexts: Stateless services use a canary rollout: the new version first receives 5% of traffic for 15 minutes, then 25% for 15 minutes, and finally 100% (Figure 2). The API Gateway uses blue-green deployment.

query: What conditions trigger an automatic rollback during a canary release?
ground_truth_answer: A rollback is triggered if HTTP 5xx error rate exceeds 2% for 5 consecutive minutes, p95 latency exceeds 2x baseline for 5 consecutive minutes, failed health checks affect more than 20% of new pods or a crash loop occurs, or a confirmed SEV1/SEV2 defect originates from the release.
relevant_contexts: HTTP 5xx error rate above 2% for 5 consecutive minutes. p95 latency above 2 times the baseline for 5 consecutive minutes. Failed health checks on more than 20% of new pods, or a crash loop.

query: During what time window are standard releases allowed?
ground_truth_answer: Standard releases are allowed on Tuesday and Thursday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM (Pakistan Standard Time), with approval from the release manager and service owner.
relevant_contexts: Standard release | Tuesday and Thursday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM | Release manager and service owner

query: How quickly must a SEV1 incident be acknowledged, and how often should updates be sent?
ground_truth_answer: A SEV1 incident (complete outage or data loss affecting many customers) must be acknowledged within 15 minutes, with updates sent every 30 minutes.
relevant_contexts: SEV1 | Complete outage or data loss affecting many customers | 15 minutes | Every 30 minutes

query: Is a written post-mortem required after a SEV1 or SEV2 incident?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, SEV1 and SEV2 incidents require a written post-mortem within 3 working days, following a blameless format.
relevant_contexts: SEV1 and SEV2 incidents require a written post-mortem within 3 working days, following a blameless format.

query: What percentage of basic salary does an employee contribute to the provident fund, and does the company match it?
ground_truth_answer: Every confirmed employee contributes 8% of basic salary to the Nexora Provident Fund, and the company matches it with another 8%. The employee's own contribution is always fully owned, while ownership of the company's contribution vests over time.
relevant_contexts: Every confirmed employee contributes 8% of basic salary to the Nexora Provident Fund, and the company contributes a matching 8%. The employee's own contribution is always fully owned; ownership of the company's contribution increases with service.

query: What is the hospitalisation insurance limit for a Grade G6 employee?
ground_truth_answer: Grade G5 and G6 employees have a hospitalisation limit of PKR 1,500,000 per policy year, with an outpatient (OPD) limit of PKR 75,000.

query: How much is the festival bonus paid before each Eid?
ground_truth_answer: The festival bonus is 50% of basic salary, paid before each Eid (Eid ul-Fitr and Eid ul-Adha) to confirmed employees.
relevant_contexts: Festival bonus: 50% of basic salary paid before each Eid (Eid ul-Fitr and Eid ul-Adha) to confirmed employees.

query: How much on-call allowance does an engineer get per day, and extra for handling a SEV1 incident?
ground_truth_answer: Engineers on the on-call rotation receive PKR 3,000 per day on call, plus PKR 8,000 for each SEV1 or SEV2 incident handled.
relevant_contexts: On-call allowance | PKR 3,000 per day on call; PKR 8,000 for each SEV1 or SEV2 incident handled | Engineers in the on-call rotation
